meta.title: Hantari — Software & AI studio
meta.description: Hantari is a software & AI studio. We digitalise businesses, modernise their software and bring ideas to life — for businesses, organisations and people with an idea, from Timișoara to anywhere.

nav.notSureText: Tell us what you have in mind — an idea, a process or a business you want to take online. We’ll suggest where to begin.
nav.aboutLine: Who we are and where we work
nav.approachLine: How a project runs, start to finish

apps.name: Web & desktop apps
apps.long: We build the software you need — internal tools and customer-facing apps, made to last.

page.intro: Web and desktop apps designed around the people who use them — from internal tools to platforms for your customers.

process.d: Together we define what the app needs to do.
Sketches and a clickable prototype, so you can see the app before it’s built.
We split the work into clear stages, each with a deadline.
We build in stages; you get a test version within the first weeks.
We publish the app and set up the domain, security and backups.
Monitoring, updates and improvements after launch.

get: A web app that works on phone and desktop
A desktop app for Windows, when needed
An admin panel for your content and data
Hosting, domain and SSL certificate set up
You own the source code and documentation
fit: A first product (MVP) for a new idea

automation.name: Automation
automation.long: We make your business processes run with less manual work.

page.intro: The steps that repeat — copying data, sending emails, creating documents — can run on their own, correctly and on time, giving your team hours back for work that matters.

process.d: We follow the process end to end and see what repeats and what can run by itself.
We start with the automations that give back the most time.
Flows, scripts and integrations that do the repetitive work for you.
We run alongside the way you work today until everything comes out right.
We show you how it works, and you get alerts if anything needs attention.

get: Documents, invoices and reports created automatically
Emails and notifications sent at the right moment
Data kept in sync between apps, no manual copying
A dashboard showing everything that runs

ai.name: AI solutions
ai.line: AI that works for your business
ai.long: We put AI to work in your business: assistants, document processing and search that know your data.

page.intro: Assistants, document processing and smart search — AI connected to your data and tools, working for your business.

process.d: We start from a concrete task where AI brings value you can measure.
We decide what information it uses and what it may do — your data stays under your control.
A working prototype within days, tested on real examples.
We connect the AI to your apps: calendar, email, database, invoicing.
We measure answer quality and keep improving.

get: An assistant that answers from your own documents
Data extracted automatically from PDFs, invoices and emails
Search across documents in plain language
Agents that take actions: bookings, orders, summaries

integrations.name: Integrations
integrations.line: Your tools — and AI — working together
integrations.long: We make your existing software talk to each other, and connect AI to the tools you already use.

page.intro: The software you already use can work together — data flows by itself between your shop, invoicing, couriers and calendar.

process.d: We list your apps and the data that needs to move between them.
We decide who sends what, when, and what happens in every case.
We build the links through each service’s official APIs.
We check every flow with real data, including the rarer cases.
You get alerts if a connection needs attention.

get: e-Factura (ANAF) sent automatically from your shop or app
SmartBill or Oblio connected to WooCommerce: an order becomes an invoice
Shipping labels created automatically (FAN Courier, Sameday, Cargus)
Bookings synced with Google Calendar and Meet
Online payments with Stripe or Netopia
AI on top: summaries, answers, extracted data
fit: Practices and services that take bookings

modernisation.name: Modernisation
modernisation.long: We bring your old software up to modern standards.

page.intro: The software that keeps your business moving can be brought up to date — faster, more secure and easier to maintain, without stopping your work.

process.d: We look at what you have: code, data, hosting, security — and what’s worth keeping.
We choose the right path: update, rebuild in stages or replace.
We move features one at a time, without pausing your business.
We migrate data with checks and backups at every step.
Modern hosting, automatic backups and regular updates.

get: Your app on modern technology
Moved to the cloud (AWS or Vercel) with automatic backups
Better security and controlled access
Better performance and clear hosting costs
Documentation for the whole system
fit: Systems that grew with the business
Own servers ready to move to the cloud
Excel or Access records that have grown too big

home.title: <services>Digitalising</services> businesses, modernising software, bringing ideas to life.
home.intro: Hantari is a software & AI studio for businesses, organisations and people with an idea — from the first sketch to launch and beyond, with clear prices and deadlines agreed up front.
home.servicesIntro: A small team that moves fast and delivers — from the first conversation to the software running in your business.
home.lactaText: A bilingual website for a lactation consulting practice — services, reviews and resources the owner runs herself, with online booking and an AI assistant that guides visitors through the site’s resources and gets them to a booking quickly.
home.approachLead: We help businesses go digital, bring older software up to date and turn ideas into real solutions — built carefully, explained plainly and supported after launch.
home.step1Title: Start from the idea — or from how you work today.
home.step1Text: A business to digitalise, an old system to modernise or a brand-new idea: first we understand what exists and agree together what “better” means.
home.step2Text: Working versions early and often — your idea takes shape in front of you, and you always know what you’re paying for.
home.step3Text: Hosting, monitoring and updates handled. The people who built it stay with you — so tomorrow works better than today.
home.ctaTitle: Have an idea or a business you want to take digital?
home.ctaText: Tell us about it. You’ll hear from us within 1 business day with a clear next step.

about.title: A small studio for practical software.
about.intro: Hantari is a software & AI studio based in Timișoara, Romania, working with people everywhere. Our vision is simple: help businesses go digital, bring older software up to modern standards and turn good ideas into working products — using AI where it solves a real problem.
about.p1Text: We explain what we’re building and why, in words you’d use yourself.
about.p2Text: Success means time saved and mistakes avoided.
about.p3Text: Solid infrastructure, security and support after launch.
about.p4Text: Steady, consistent progress, day after day — that’s how we build things that last.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draftNote: Hantari is being registered. The company’s identification details will be added here as soon as registration is complete.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
p: The controller of your data is Hantari — a software & AI studio in Timișoara, Romania, represented by Hantari Beneamin Andrei. Until the company is registered, your data is handled by him personally.
For any question about your data, write to us at hello@hantari.ro.

sections.title: 2. What we collect
p: We only collect what we need to reply to you:
items: What you enter in the “Start a project” form: name, email and, optionally, company or organisation and phone.
What you tell us about the project: the services you’re interested in, the description, the tools you use today and when you’d like to start.
The language you’d like us to reply in.
Email correspondence, if you write to us directly.
Minimal technical data kept automatically by our hosting provider for security (for example IP address and browser type).

sections.title: 3. Why we use it and on what legal basis
items: To reply to you and prepare a proposal at your request — steps prior to entering a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and on the basis of the consent you give in the form (Art. 6(1)(a)).
To keep the website secure and working — our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)).
If we work together, for legal invoicing and accounting obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)).
p2: We don’t sell your data, use it for advertising or send you newsletters without separate consent.

sections.title: 4. Who we share it with
p: We use a few trusted providers that process data only on our behalf:
items: Vercel — website hosting.
Neon — the database where requests are stored (hosted in the EU).
Resend — sending confirmation and notification emails.
Google Workspace — our email.
p2: Some of these providers are US companies. When data leaves the European Economic Area, the transfer relies on the EU–US Data Privacy Framework or on the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses.

sections.title: 5. How long we keep it
items: Requests sent through the form: up to 24 months, then deleted.
If you become a client: for the duration of our work together, then as long as the law requires for financial and accounting records.
Technical security data: a few days, according to the hosting provider’s settings.

sections.title: 6. Cookies
p: We use a single, strictly necessary cookie that remembers your language (NEXT_LOCALE). No advertising, tracking or analytics cookies.

sections.title: 7. How we protect it
p: The website only uses encrypted connections (HTTPS), access to data is limited to us, and the accounts we use are protected with two-step verification.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
p: Under the GDPR you have the right to:
items: know what data we hold about you and get a copy;
have it corrected or deleted;
restrict or object to its processing;
receive it in a portable format;
withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting processing done before.
p2: Write to hello@hantari.ro — we reply within one month at most. You can also complain to the Romanian data protection authority (ANSPDCP), www.dataprotection.ro.

sections.title: 9. Children
p: Our services are not aimed at people under 16 and we don’t knowingly collect their data.

sections.title: 10. Changes
p: If we change this policy, we update the date above. For important changes, we’ll let you know on the website.
